step1.text:
Orthogonal (Icypeas lead database): Find people at a company or in a segment. query takes filters such as currentJobTitle, currentCompanyWebsite, currentCompanyName, location, school or skills, each {include: [...]}. Returns names, headlines, current role and LinkedIn URLs; no emails or phones.
Price: $0.01 per call, paid by this machine's wallet straight to the provider.
Request: POST https://x402.orthogonal.com/icypeas/api/find-people
Inputs:
- query (object {currentJobTitle, currentCompanyWebsite, currentCompanyName, pastJobTitle, pastCompanyName, firstname, lastname, locatio...}, required); One or more filters, each {"include": [...], "exclude": [...]}.
- pagination (object {size, token})
Example input: {"query":{"currentCompanyWebsite":{"include":["stripe.com"]},"currentJobTitle":{"include":["CTO"]}},"pagination":{"size":5}}
Returns: JSON {total, success, leads[]}: per person first and last name, headline, LinkedIn profileUrl, current job title and company; no emails
To run it, call request({id: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004", input: {...}}) with the inputs above. Nothing has been paid.
